note: Shorts cut from the public demo masters. Each entry is a run of storyboard steps (from..to) on the parent's timeline.json; the clip starts and ends on whole narrated sentences and runs 30 to 60 s with the closing card. hook is the title card for the first 2 s and the Short's title (plain facts, no em dashes). crop (optional) is { w: fraction of the source width shown in the panel, focus: 0 left to 1 right }; without it shorts.mjs looks for the busiest part of the frame. Short keys are <parent>-short<n> and are only ever published when listed under shorts in the public allowlist.
